i.norm:
Verifies that the shared {@link Soundex#US_ENGLISH} static instance correctly encodes a well-known surname using the standard US-English Soundex algorithm.

"Williams" should encode to "W452":

  • W – kept as the leading letter
  • 4 – L (code 4)
  • 5 – M (code 5)
  • 2 – N (code 2), while adjacent vowels and H/W are ignored

Using the static instance (rather than constructing a new {@code Soundex()}) validates that the shared singleton is properly initialised and thread-safe — bugs reported in CODEC-54 and CODEC-56 were caused by incorrect initialisation of this static field. @see CODEC-54 @see CODEC-56
